{{Quote|Their jabberin' sounds like an extinct language to me.|Kam Solusar|<ref name="DEII3" />}}
'''Ysannan'''<ref name="EGtPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> was the language of the [[Ysanna/Legends|Ysanna]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="DEII3" />

{{Language-stub}}

==Known words and phrases==
*''Bnatu ekouda Jedi!''<ref name="DEII4" />
*''Dassadeo krova!''<ref name="EE1">[[Empire's End 1|''Empire's End'' 1]]</ref>
*''Fnar tlen nukota!'' &mdash; "Lightsabers!"<ref name="DEII3" />
*''Fstno.''<ref name="DEII3" />
*''Fstno krvoz lecto makao!''<ref name="DEII3" />
*''Glio svbas, nurra, Jem.''<ref name="DEII3" />
*''Glio&hellip;svbas&hellip;Rayf&hellip;''<ref name="DEII6" />
*''Glio svbas, Jem&hellip;''<ref name="DEII6" />
*''J'na ke floo, murra.''<ref name="DEII3" />
*''J'na ke makao!''<ref name="DEII5" />
*''Kneeto burona fenta cha trukvo!''<ref name="DEII3" />
*''Knutta!''<ref name="DEII5">[[Dark Empire II 5|''Dark Empire II'' 5]]</ref>
*''Krova! Dassadeo!''<ref name="DEII3" />
*''Krova shvar, Jem!''<ref name="DEII3" />
*''Krova makao!''<ref name="DEII6">[[Dark Empire II 6|''Dark Empire II'' 6]]</ref>
*''Makao? Ne macha!! Tsan mch sonta Jedi!''<ref name="DEII3" />
*''Makao tyllup!''<ref name="DEII4" />
*''Mth son makao!''<ref name="DEII6" />
*''N'kao tnedra fenrth!''<ref name="DEII3" />
*''N'kao shutha&hellip;''<ref name="DEII4">[[Dark Empire II 4|''Dark Empire II'' 4]]</ref>
*''N'kao kutha!''<ref name="DEII5" />
*''N'kow!''<ref name="DEII5" />
*''N'otun kao svbas, Luke&hellip;''<ref name="EE1" />
*''Ne makao?''<ref name="DEII3" />
*''Ne makao!''<ref name="DEII3" />
*''Nekouda!''<ref name="DEII3" /><ref name="EE1" />
*''Nkoo tatem dasadars!''<ref name="DEII3" />
*''Ntha!''<ref name="EE2">[[Empire's End 2|''Empire's End'' 2]]</ref>
*''Nukota makao!''<ref name="EE1" />
*''Okko! Fnabbu!''<ref name="DEII3" />
*''Ood nrfotith ke letta&hellip;J'nin ta.'' &mdash; "Master Ood is gone, but I think he left a descendant!"<ref name="DEII3" />
*''Poonta krova slyptudd! Knuuto!''<ref name="DEII3" />
*''Rayf! Kriva nath l'onta Jedi!''<ref name="EE1" />
*''Snon fvnne ptumab&hellip;Sheff tlottoon!''<ref name="DEII3" />
*''T'fonn ptunab!''<ref name="DEII6" />
*''Tao di Jedi&hellip;'' &mdash; "I am a Jedi&hellip;"<ref name="DEII3" />
*''Te fonn gavw bvais!''<ref name="DEII3" />
*''Tsan makao!''<ref name="EE1" />
*''Tsan makao! Krdna moja!!''<ref name="DEII3" />
*''Tsan mch sonta Jedi!''<ref name="DEII3" />
